# Self-authored storyboard import fixtures

These synthetic files isolate editable-layer import, fitting, clipping, blend
metadata, ordering and Undo. `scripts/generate_storyboard_import_fixtures.py`
creates them with psd-tools 1.23.0, independently of Emulsion's PSD exporter.
The pixels are solid colors created for Emulsion's MIT-licensed test suite.
No third-party artwork or third-party editor is involved. `manifest.json`
pins the bytes, layer graph and exact RGBA8 colors; the UI fixture deliberately
retains fractional source alpha (153 and 128).

The optional VersionInfo resource is absent. Any preview is generated by
psd-tools, not a third-party current-appearance/profile reference. These fixtures
must not be used as third-party renderer or blend-gamma goldens.

The old import tests first exported default-Linear native documents containing
Multiply/Screen, then assumed editable PSD output. The appearance-preserving
export guard correctly flattens those incompatible scenes. Keeping that setup
would test export policy accidentally, rather than import placement. Original
layer-count, blend, clip, fitting and Undo assertions remain intact. A separate
MCP regression preserves the old native Linear scene and requires the explicit
BlendSpaceDifference export report without mutating its source document.
